title: Marguerite and the Clock
author: Bram Halloran
blurb: August Villalobos, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, has spent twelve years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians before the century turns.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
